requirements.critical_unresolved_candidate_input: Matched candidate imaging completeness, identity across transfers, observation gaps, division and elapsed-time exposure definitions remain unchosen.
requirements.known_source_evidence: Imaging independently records lineage relationships and division intervals; sequence-only ancestry lacks those division counts.

requirements.critical_unresolved_candidate_input: Candidate founder genotype, mosaic starting state, parental alleles and independent reference validation are unresolved.
requirements.known_source_evidence: Founder reference is needed at the top split; the source uses separate reference information.

requirements.critical_unresolved_candidate_input: Actual common ancestor, contexts, allele/copy-number state and background matching need independent qualification.
requirements.known_source_evidence: HT115 and RPE1 differ in origin, genotype, media and estimated ploidy; this is no matched TMD context panel.

requirements.critical_unresolved_candidate_input: Unobserved genotypes cannot be filled as reference; extinct lineages and tracking losses need distinct censored/missing categories.
requirements.known_source_evidence: Death is visible in the pedigree; collection, isolation, outgrowth and sequencing each omit cells.

requirements.critical_unresolved_candidate_input: Route-specific origin-to-included-event ascertainment and native control transport are uncalibrated.
requirements.known_source_evidence: Source branch calls need related-subclone evidence; caller consistency and nested cell-stage fractions are different measurements.

requirements.critical_unresolved_candidate_input: Lock molecular event/episode units and uncertain branch assignments; do not infer exact event time from inherited copies.
requirements.known_source_evidence: A branch variant is shared by descendants and assigned to a lineage segment, not counted as a new birth in every sample.

requirements.critical_unresolved_candidate_input: Actual branch/caller/quality predicate and handling of leaf-only evidence must be prospectively reviewed.
requirements.known_source_evidence: Leaf variants can originate in the last generation, later subclonal growth or technical error.

requirements.critical_unresolved_candidate_input: Actual dependence/episode grouping and a justified observation likelihood remain unresolved; no imported count law.
requirements.known_source_evidence: Observed heterogeneity departs from homogeneous Poisson accrual, and neighboring SNVs may share an episode.

requirements.critical_unresolved_candidate_input: Actual replicate allocation and donor/founder/batch/shared-culture dependence structure need a study-level design.
requirements.known_source_evidence: Displayed related descendants arise from one founder per cell-line background; founding and subsampling are selection bottlenecks.

requirements.critical_unresolved_candidate_input: Known-input state-matched event/call controls and uncertainty/transport checks remain missing.
requirements.known_source_evidence: Caller sensitivity/specificity are internally estimated from consensus lineage consistency; independent validation is explicitly limited.

requirements.critical_unresolved_candidate_input: Candidate callable territory, reference version, assay thresholds and immutable route/axis definitions remain unresolved.
requirements.known_source_evidence: Copy-number and reference state affect allele interpretation and genomic opportunity.

requirements.critical_unresolved_candidate_input: Prospective thresholds, fixed stopping/looks, held-out eta, multiplicity and joint errors need a qualified plan.
requirements.known_source_evidence: Bias checks have limited targets and the study reports insufficient power for time-versus-division discrimination.

requirements.critical_unresolved_candidate_input: An actual candidate requires authorized immutable data/version/call receipts and a privacy review; cached summaries do not supply raw data.
